summary: Author up to three slides per call, warm up serially, then allow two calls; downgrade on overload and recover failed slides once.
invariants: A provider call authors at most three slides.
The first authoring wave is serial; after a healthy success, at most two batch calls may run concurrently.
An overload-class failure downgrades the current job to serial authoring.
Accepted slides are checkpointed and never regenerated; only failed slides receive at most one recovery call.
forbidden: Regenerating an accepted slide during batch recovery.
